_comment: jbreaking-walls configuration — all fields are documented below.
_target_fps_doc: Logical fixed-step rate used for physics. Rendering is uncapped (VSync).
_show_debug_overlay_doc: Display FPS + frame-time overlay in the top-right corner.
_runner_speed_doc: Starting horizontal scroll speed in world-units/sec. 1 world-unit ≈ 1 tile.
_runner_acceleration_doc: Speed increase per second. Set to 0 to disable escalating difficulty.
_runner_max_speed_doc: Hard cap on horizontal speed. Prevents the game from becoming unplayable.
_runner_jump_velocity_doc: Upward velocity applied on jump input (world-units/sec). Larger = higher arc.
_runner_gravity_doc: Downward acceleration (negative = toward ground). Raise magnitude for snappier landings.
_runner_starting_points_doc: Initial health/points. Obstacle hits drain this; reaching 0 ends the run.
_score_per_meter_doc: Points earned per world-unit of distance scrolled.
_score_multiplier_increment_doc: How much the score multiplier grows at each milestone.
_score_milestone_bonus_doc: Flat bonus points awarded when a milestone is reached.
_runner_pickup_min_value_doc: Lowest point value a pickup can carry. Negative = health drain (purple gem).
_runner_pickup_max_value_doc: Highest point value a pickup can carry (gold gem).
_runner_pickup_spacing_doc: Minimum world-unit gap between consecutive pickup spawn positions.
_runner_obstacle_penalty_doc: Points subtracted from health on each obstacle collision.
_runner_collision_cooldown_doc: Seconds of invincibility granted after an obstacle hit (prevents double-hits).
_randomness_seed_doc: RNG seed for world generation. 0 = use system clock (unique every run). Any other value = fully deterministic/repeatable run.
_randomness_obstacle_density_doc: Probability [0.0–1.0] that a spawn slot is an obstacle. 0 = no obstacles, 1 = solid wall of obstacles.
_randomness_pickup_density_doc: Probability [0.0–1.0] that a non-obstacle spawn slot contains a pickup. Remaining slots are empty.
_shader_quad_vert_doc: Classpath-relative path to the vertex shader for all game geometry.
_shader_quad_frag_doc: Classpath-relative path to the fragment shader for all game geometry.
